mentions.name: Singularity
mentions.description: A tiny macOS menu bar app that stops the Dock from jumping between monitors. Since there is no API to pin the Dock to one screen, it keeps the cursor off the bottom edge of the other displays so the Dock can only appear on the intended screen. It runs without a Dock icon.
mentions.problem: macOS offers no API to pin the Dock to one screen, so the Dock jumps between monitors.
mentions.source_excerpt: Singularity (https://apps.apple.com/us/app/singularity-dock-anchor/id6791258123?mt=12), a tiny menu bar app that stops the macOS Dock from jumping between monitors. There's no API to pin the Dock to one screen, so it just keeps your cursor off the bottom edge of the others and the Dock has nowhere else to appear.
